Final runtime YAML document: steps: [] MaxConcurrency: 0 Environment type: Self-Hosted Server type: Azure DevOps Server Server version: Azure DevOps Server 2022.2 Agent version: 4.275.0 Operating system: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP6 This is my entire yaml file presently: trigger: none jobs: - job: Build pool: name: [pool name] demands: - Agent.Name -equals '[name]' steps: - checkout: none I don't understand why system-pre-steps.yml is imposing a restriction of Agent.Version -gtVersion 5.279.0, or if it's not imposing it itself, it's being imposed from elsewhere. I have attempted to specify agent version 4.275.0 but I receive the same error as it attempts to match agent version 4.275.0 and agent version greater than 5.279.0 which is obviously impossible. As documentation is sorely lacking, I am unsure as to how to proceed from here. I cannot simply update the agent as the Linux operating system I am attempting to host the agent on cannot support .NET 10 which is required by agent versions 5.XXX.X. Nothing in the Microsoft documentation that I found mentions a 'system-pre-steps.yml' and I am unsure as to why it's even required. Has anybody else run into this issue? How can I bypass these restrictions?
